NONE: › a number of usually flat and/or small objects pressed tightly together
一疊；一捆；一捲
› to fold or press together something to form a mass
折疊；壓折

example: a wad of banknotes
一疊鈔票
a wad of gum
一塊口香糖
She used a wad (= a mass) of tissues to wipe away the blood.
她用一團紙巾擦掉了那些血。
He wadded his towel into a ball.
他把毛巾壓折成一個球。

NONE: › any soft material used for filling a space, especially in order to protect something or to give something shape
填塞物，填絮，填料，襯墊

example: The chandelier arrived in a big box, tightly packed around in wadding.
那盞枝形吊燈運來了，裝在一個大箱子裡，四周用填料塞得緊緊的。

NONE: › (usually of a person or animal with short legs and a fat body) to walk with short steps, moving the body from one side to the other
（通常指肥胖腿短的人或動物）蹣跚而行，搖搖擺擺地走
› a heavy stick
棍棒，木棍

I usually + adv/prep, T: › [ I usually + adv/prep,  T ] mainly UK to walk through water or other liquid with some effort, because it is deep enough to come quite high up your legs, or thick
I: › [ I ] US UK paddle to walk in water that is not very deep

example: The river was full but we managed to wade across.
河裡漲滿了水，但我們設法蹚過去了。
We waded a shallow river.
我們涉水過了一條淺淺的小河。
They had to wade through a swamp.
他們不得不艱難地步行穿過沼澤地。
We rolled up our trousers and waded at the edge of the lake.
我們卷起褲腳沿著湖邊蹚水而行。

NONE: › to start to do or say something in a forceful way, often without thinking about it carefully
插手，介入；插嘴

example: Even when she knows nothing about it, she wades in with her opinion.
即使對事情一無所知，她也要插嘴說說自己的意見。
When the crowd started throwing bottles, the police waded in with tear gas.
當人群開始投擲石塊的時候，警方用催淚彈進行了干預。

NONE: › to become involved in a difficult situation, often without thinking about it carefully
貿然涉足；貿然插手
› to spend a lot of time and effort doing something boring or difficult, especially reading a lot of information
費力地做（乏味或困難之事）；（尤指）費勁地閱讀（大量資訊）

example: We had to wade through pages of legal jargon before we could sign the contract.
我們在簽合同之前必須費力地讀完好幾頁的法律行話。

C: › [ C ] a bird with long legs and a long neck, that lives near water and eats fish

NONE: › rubber boots that cover the whole leg to keep a person dry in water
高筒防水膠靴

example: The fishermen put on their waders.
漁民們穿上了高筒防水膠靴。

NONE: › a
wodge
› a valley that has a river that is usually dry except when it has rained, common in desert areas of North Africa and Western Asia
（常見於北非和西亞沙漠地區、只在雨季有水的）乾谷，乾河床
› a pool that is not deep that small children can play in
（供兒童嬉水的）淺水池
